tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example} ↗ ex:real-projective-space-metric ↗ prop:rp-n-frame-homogeneous ↗ prob:rp-n-frame-homogeneous ↗ prob:elliptic-geometry-hilbert 1. ch5:5.30

The real projective plane $\mathbb {RP}^2$ carries a frame-homogeneous metric $g$ locally isometric to a round metric on $S^n$ by Example 2.34 and section prop:rp-n-frame-homogeneous. With points given by elements of $\mathbb {RP}^2$ and lines by images of maximal geodesics, the incidence postulates and the elliptic parallel postulate hold. This is single elliptic geometry. \end{example}
